gap-004.response: EMBEDDING_MODEL_DIR is missing from /etc/substrate/env. The F-V58 fix added this env var to the Dockerfile for the canary image, but scripts/substrate/gen-env.sh does not set it. The model file IS present at /vessels/activity-api/src/assets/models/ per audit F-014. Fix: add EMBEDDING_MODEL_DIR to /etc/substrate/env and restart activity-api. This enables dense search for template recommendations. WITH embedding disabled, literal template name queries fell through to BM25 FTS which may not match on template ID fragments — explaining why 'run coverage-tick' goals did not resolve to that template. Now with templateId boredom tasks, this matters less (no FTS needed to select the template), but fixing it improves general recommendation quality.

gap-005.response: Template churn was caused by boredom tasks using goal: field → goal-processing pipeline → Thompson sampling → stagnation detector dropped coverage-tick/substrate-health-tick after 3 repeats → improviser ran → ribosome-extract created timestamp-variant IDs → development-vessel restart (boredom timer or observer) re-registered seed templates, causing the non-monotonic adds/removes. Fix: all 5 topology boredom tasks switched from goal: to templateId: format. The templateId path loads the template by ID directly, bypasses goal-processing and stagnation entirely. Registry thrashing should stop once the substrate picks up the queue change. Note: existing timestamp-suffixed variant IDs in the registry (activity:⟨variant-17795...⟩) are harmless but stale — they can be pruned via prune-activity template.
